summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the cipher-box milestone using the GSD manager workflow, fixing 5 data-integrity bugs across unpin authorization, advisory-lock concurrency, CID validation, and on-demand IPNS subtree traversal.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged (Wave 1: 50-01/02/03/05 in parallel; Wave 2: 50-04), code review found and fixed 2 blockers + 3 warnings in the new traversal code, phase verified and marked complete, simplification pass applied, Nyquist validation confirmed, todos consolidated, and security review initiated. PR creation and CodeRabbit review remain pending.

repo: api-client (132 files) is regenerated by pnpm api:generate and resolves to the workspace root — running this in a worktree leaks regenerated files into the main working tree because worktrees share root node_modules
husky regenerates .husky/_/* stubs whenever pnpm install runs in a worktree, causing cleanup-wave to report the worktree as dirty even though all plan work is committed
todos/done/ (70 items, frozen ~2026-06-15) and todos/completed/ (canonical per GSD tooling) drifted apart; GSD tools reference completed/ exclusively — done/ was legacy and has now been consolidated
gsd_run commit helper has a known false-negative: reports commit_failed but the commit actually lands; always verify via git log before retrying
init.manager dep-string parser mis-parses version strings like 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' — the '1.1' is treated as a phantom phase dependency, falsely marking deps unsatisfied

The pre-commit hook runs check-api-client.sh + pnpm lint-staged (eslint+prettier across all staged api-client files); with 131+ files staged this needs a generous timeout and is the likely silent failure point in the cleanup-wave merge helper
phase.complete reports a false-positive 'needs human verification' warning when previous_status: human_needed appears anywhere in the VERIFICATION.md frontmatter history
VALIDATION.md grep assertions can false-positive on renaming comments (e.g., 'renamed from outboxRowInserted') — the variable name itself is correctly changed but the comment retains the old name

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync had no visited set despite its docstring claiming to mirror the ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern and the shared walker both carrying one — a folder cycle causes unbounded recursion. Fixed by adding a visited: Set<string> param with skip-on-already-visited guard.

Four fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites used .then() with no .catch() — unhandled rejection on IPNS unenroll failure. Fixed by adding .catch() at all four sites, then refactored into a single fireAndForgetUnenrollEntries() helper by /simplify.
Refcount guard added here: skips physical unpin in the drain loop when CID has been re-pinned since the pending-unpin row was created, preventing WR-03 data-loss race.

Comment 'renamed from outboxRowInserted' at line 251 — the actual variable is shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin at lines 254/306/312. VALIDATION grep assertions against the old name will false-positive on this comment.

CID validation regex uses {44} (exactly 44 chars) — diverges from RegisterCidDto which uses {44,} (44 or more). This inconsistency is deferred as a todo (WR-02) since RegisterCidDto is out of this phase's scope.

workflow: When the gsd cleanup-wave merge helper fails silently (merge_failed, empty stderr, HEAD unchanged), check for a dangling MERGE_HEAD — the merge applied cleanly but the hook-gated commit step timed out; complete the merge manually with git commit (hooks enabled, generous timeout)

After worktrees that run api-client regeneration are merged, the main working tree will contain the regenerated files as uncommitted changes — verify all match the merged branch content (git show branch:file), then git checkout to discard before proceeding with the next worktree merge
Worktree base-check shouldDegrade:false with reason baseref-head means executors fork from current HEAD — PLAN files must already be committed before dispatching Wave 1
The cleanup-wave helper requires a fully clean orchestrator working tree; STATE.md written by state.begin-phase does not block it, but leaked working-tree files from api-client regeneration do

Cross-plan integration validation: build+typecheck across the full package chain (sdk → api → web tsc -b) is more valuable than running the full monorepo test suite in parallel, which risks RAM starvation on integration tests requiring local infra

friction: cleanup-wave merge helper failed silently for two worktrees: 50-05 (husky stubs in worktree) and again (api-client files leaked into main tree from prior merges triggering post-commit hooks) — required multiple diagnostic rounds and manual git merge completion

api-client regeneration in worktrees leaks 131 files into main working tree because pnpm/orval resolves to workspace root, not the worktree path — discovered mid-merge, required per-file blob hash verification before discarding
init.manager mis-parsed the Phase 49 dependency string ('v1.1 baseline' → phantom phase '1.1'), requiring manual override to confirm Phase 50 was genuinely ready to execute
gsd commit helper false-negative caused repeated unnecessary verification steps (git log check after every commit)
cleanup-wave left MERGE_HEAD dangling with opaque 'merge_failed' error and empty stderr, requiring manual diagnosis to determine the pre-commit hook was the failure point
VALIDATION.md grep assertion for IN-06 false-positived on a renaming comment, requiring source inspection to confirm the fix was actually correct
open_items: WR-02: RegisterCidDto CID regex uses {44,} while UnpinDto uses {44} — divergence deferred because RegisterCidDto is outside Phase 50 scope; filed as a todo
WR-05: LocalProvider unescaped CID in shell command — file not touched in Phase 50, deferred as a todo
WR-01: Advisory lock now held across Kubo network call in the pending-unpin drain (low-frequency batched path) — accepted trade-off, flagged to security review for final disposition
IpfsProviderModule circular import comment is factually incorrect (IPFS_PROVIDER only needs ConfigService, not VaultModule) — accepted as deferred refactor rather than expanding Phase 50 scope
Advisory-lock SQL duplicated in 3 places — a shared withCidLock+refcount primitive would eliminate the duplication but was deferred as architectural debt
5 REQ-IDs missing from REQUIREMENTS traceability table (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) — pre-existing doc-sync debt surfaced by phase.complete, not introduced by Phase 50
Two orphan worktree branches (a92edd36, abd7998d) on the repo from a prior session have no attached worktrees — left untouched to avoid unintended scope
